out.qualifying_criteria: YES requires Haley Stevens to win the Democratic nomination for United States Senator from Michigan in the 2026 primary. Polling leads, endorsements, fundraising, spending, and intentions do not qualify. Winning a different primary or the general election does not qualify. Another candidate winning means Stevens does not win; if no such primary takes place, the rules specify resolution to Other. The designated resolution source is the first announcement of results from the Michigan Democratic Party, with overwhelming consensus of credible reporting also sufficient.
